rows.why: the release: the impossible fire travels up through the water

rows.raymi: (small) - the flame bursts THROUGH the surface into the sky and explodes into LETTERS: 'FIRE STARTER' written across the sky in violet-gold sparks, mirrored in the sea; two more shells burst on 175.29 / 175.54
rows.lyric: FIRE STARTER - firework letters in the sky (new kind: firework)
rows.why: WOW 5: fire from under the water writes the song across the sky

rows.raymi: (off screen) - shells rise from all over the glowing sea and burst through the surface on each hit, each writing
rows.lyric: work a lil harder - firework letters (firework)
rows.why: the whole sea answers - from below

rows.camera: racing beside her, half under, half above
rows.raymi: SURF_125 (cut left out of frame) surfs the path of light toward the horizon
rows.why: a ray riding the glow (no mount)

rows.raymi: small on the path (why_small) - on 'like' the whole horizon lights at once
rows.why: the hang is finished by the picture

rows.raymi: (off screen) - I'm a fire starter written in sparks, biggest
rows.lyric: I'm a fire starter - firework letters
rows.why: the biggest words of the video - the sky is the last lyric surface

rows.raymi: SURF_126 (cut bottom hidden by the spray) laughing as two shells burst above her
rows.why: her joy in the middle of her fireworks

rows.camera: low over the water ahead of her
rows.raymi: SURF_126 rushes at the lens through the reflections
rows.why: speed toward the lens before the last stamps

rows.raymi: (off screen) - firework 1, near
rows.why: the signature move as fireworks: one per 'I'm a'

rows.raymi: (off screen) - firework 2, farther
rows.why: stamp 2 - each farther, the whole sea is hers

rows.raymi: (off screen) - firework 3, farthest
rows.why: stamp 3 - the farthest, the horizon

rows.raymi: MS_HAPPY_006 spins to the lens and points straight at you, laughing
rows.why: the signature move ends as 'you'

rows.camera: camera sinks under the surface beside her
rows.raymi: (her legs above) - far below, the vent field glows like a city again: where she started
rows.why: the place she began, seen from where she arrived

rows.raymi: CALM_REST_164 rotated, floating on her back; a fish lights her from below
rows.why: the fish she gathered now light HER - the lamp lit by what she lit

rows.raymi: CALM_REST_164 rotated, floating; more fish light her one at a time; the rain stops; Salmon drifts by with the bucket as a pillow
rows.why: rest: the story is told, everyone she touched glows

rows.raymi: CALM_REST_166: she blows out the small flame in her hand like a birthday candle - the whole sea pulses ONE step brighter
rows.why: the fire belongs to the sea now

rows.raymi: SMUG_PLAY_045 (framed close) lit from below by the glowing sea, calm; on 196.6 the last fish passes under her and lights her face gold
rows.why: the lamp lit by what she lit

rows.raymi: SMUG_PLAY_045 (ECU): one last late firework blooms in the sky - reflected in her eye; she smiles
rows.why: a last event in the quiet - the whole video in one reflection (review script_1 FIX 1)

rows.set_size: nightsea, CU face (the cold open framing)
rows.camera: the SAME framing as shot 1, locked
rows.raymi: SLEEP_129 - her eyes close on the last note
rows.why: the last frame repeats the first: the promise kept
